h1: WooCommerce plugin development, built clean and tested
overview: We build your WooCommerce plugin to WordPress coding standards, so it is safe to install, update and remove. After agreeing the features in writing, we write the plugin with proper hooks, a settings page, sanitized input and translation-ready text. We test it with current WooCommerce, High-Performance Order Storage and recent PHP versions, then hand over an installable zip, the source code and short documentation.

faq: Yes. We write to the WordPress coding standards and the plugin guidelines, covering licensing, escaping, nonces, capability checks and no hidden calls. That keeps the plugin safe for stores and ready for review if you submit it.
Can you build from a sketch or a short idea?
Yes. Send notes or an example plugin you like. We turn them into a feature list and a settings outline, and you approve both in writing before we write code.
You do. The source goes into your repository, and the plugin is yours to sell, give away or keep private. There are no licence fees to us.
Will it work with my theme?
A plugin that adds admin features works with any theme. If it adds storefront output, we use WooCommerce templates and hooks, and test with common themes such as Storefront and a block theme.
